info.name: Lost & Found - Project 2 Notifications and Schemas
info.description: Project 2 endpoints. Send the V1 request first to register the historical Avro schema, then send V2 with optional reportedLocation, then publish ItemFound with the same itemId to observe ordering and notification fan-out.

item.name: 1 - Publish ItemReportedLost V1 (schema evolution starting point)

request.description: Publish the historical Avro V1 schema. Run this before V2 against a fresh Schema Registry subject.
Publish the current ItemReportedLost Avro schema. reportedLocation is optional and defaults to null in the schema.

item.name: 3 - Report that the item was found

request.description: Publish ItemFound using the same itemId key to observe same-partition order after ItemReportedLost.
